settings.title: Before you plan an order
settings.subtitle: Quick guidance for using this demonstration catalog. Confirm technical suitability and commercial terms with the distributor before purchase.

items.question: How should I choose a coating system?
items.answer: Start with the substrate, exposure, finish and application method. Use the catalog to create a shortlist, then confirm the complete technical specification with the distributor.

items.question: Can I compare minimum order quantities?
items.answer: Yes. Product cards and detail pages can show sample MOQ and quantity tiers so buyers can plan a trade enquiry.

items.question: Are the displayed products available to purchase?
items.answer: The current products are demonstration items. Live availability begins when the distributor adds and publishes real products.

items.question: Can I request volume pricing?
items.answer: Use the bulk-order or contact route to share product, pack and quantity requirements with the distributor's buying desk.
